children.game_version: Play as a 'follow the leader' game in a line.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the kicks while seated, focusing on leg extensions.
seniors.standing_version: Hold onto a chair for balance while performing the kicks and small hops.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo, smaller range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hands on the shoulders or waist of the person in front.
movement_profile.footwork: Kicks to the side, jumps forward and backward.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Minimal movement, focus on leg and foot action.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, maintaining contact with the person in front.

signature_moves.description: Kick to the side while balancing on the supporting leg.
signature_moves.name: Side Kick

signature_moves.description: Synchronized jump with both feet together.
signature_moves.name: Forward/Backward Jump

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid breaking the line or losing rhythm with the group.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Three quarter notes followed by a quarter rest or two quarter notes followed by a dotted quarter note.
music_profile.sound_description: A blend of traditional folk melodies played with modern 1960s pop-rock instrumentation, characterized by a bouncy, skipping rhythm.
music_profile.vocal_style: Instrumental focus, though some versions include lyrics.

basic_steps: Kick left foot to the left twice.
Kick right foot to the right twice.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner level; requires coordination and group synchronization.
